additional_candidate: v5_tree_f0: one bounded CatBoost sensor-feature model using existing canonical skeleton, geometry, body/world IMU; per-clip moments/quantiles/deltas and relative spectral powers. Added while V4 joint-statistics confirmation is running. No tree or M-initialized fold-1 results exist at this amendment.
last_candidate: v5_scene_f0: use uncropped scene IR/Thermal with the original X3D-S initialization and sensors. This final bounded comparison tests whether person crops remove useful tabletop/prop context. Use existing 24-frame full-image caches with grayscale IR repeated to RGB; no person detector dependency. Further architectures are out of scope for this round.
normalization_check: One 12-epoch low-learning-rate fine-tune of the unchanged V3 architecture checks whether unfreezing its video BatchNorm helps target-domain adaptation. Initialize fold 0 only from v3_x3d_f0, never from full-data or another fold. Require at least 1 percentage point standalone fold-0 improvement before fold-1/full-data continuation; the latter must start from its corresponding V3 fold-1/full-data source. This does not enter the already fixed V4 or other V5 pair search.
change: Use the official X3D-M Kinetics-400 checkpoint as initialization. The trained target architecture remains identical to V3 X3D-S: 13 frames, 160px internal spatial input, adaptive head pooling, full-context IR/Thermal with skeleton and world IMU.
isolation: This is an additional bounded study, not part of the already fixed V4 selection space. It must not change V4 weights or results. No target validation/full-data checkpoint initializes this fold-0 run.
selection: Inspect fold 0 first. Only if competitive, freeze a separate configuration before any fold-1 confirmation. Do not claim the Kinetics source score transfers to this dataset.
promotion_gate: After both video candidates finish fold 0, fit their scalar temperatures and evaluate 21-point pair blends with the V3/V4 full-context video experts, holding the old statistics weight at 0.15. At least one new video expert must be present. Require at least 1 percentage point improvement over the stronger frozen V3/V4 fold-0 blend before spending resources on V5 fold-1/full-data training. Tree replacement peaked at 66.41% on fold 0 and is rejected. No new-model fold-1 predictions exist when this gate is declared.
safety: Use only an idle GPU, log to the existing private SwanLab project, preserve all older artifacts, no automatic Kaggle submission.
